c = a + b in safeAdd: raw uint addition checked afterwards by require(c >= a)
c = a - b in safeSub: raw uint subtraction guarded by require(b <= a)
c = a * b in safeMul: raw uint multiplication guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b)
c = a / b in safeDiv: division guarded by require(b > 0)
